note: A comprehensive literature review of 28 individuals with Jaberi-Elahi syndrome documented both motor development delay and sparse hair in 26/28 (92.9%) patients.

evidence.text: A literature review of 28 patients with Jaberi-Elahi syndrome found that motor development delay and sparse hair were both present in 26 of 28 individuals (92.9%).

source.title: Jaberi-Elahi syndrome: Exploring a novel GTPBP2 mutation and a literature review
source.quote: A large numbers of patients manifest motor development delay (26/28), sparse hair (26/28), and speech disorder (24/28).
